title: perf(console): the first load stops downloading the object list, the record view and the list view package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQiZMH6HiMoqxNgbryZTptN)_

Part of #33581 (PR 1 of the card: the boundaries; the helper subpaths are PR 2, not this one)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#1` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5mBsWKVFHwHpfLNx3a` · claim 6889356674

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:控制台首次加载不再预先下载对象列表页(默认列表与保存的列表视图)、记录详情视图和 `@object-ui/plugin-list`(列表视图与画廊)。列表页改为和其它路由页一样按需加载(路由一确定就开始下载);记录详情在抽屉里第一次打开记录时才下载;`list-view`、`view:list`、`object-gallery` 三个标签改为懒加载注册。首屏脚本从 2,165,721 字节(gzip)降到 2,060,434 字节,少了约 105 KB(4.9%)。
- 为什么改:#33581 测得仪表盘等任何路由都要先下载表格、表单、记录详情等约 287 KB 才开始取数。本 PR 去掉其中能在不动共享包接口的前提下去掉的部分:`RecordDetailView` 与 `plugins-views` 两块整块离开首屏,五块合计 287,260 → 220,463 字节。
- 风险与回滚:只改加载时机,不改任何页面画什么;8 条路由在构建好的 showcase 控制台里改前改后各测一遍,全部画出、无页面错误。抽屉里第一次打开记录时多一帧详情骨架屏。`plugin-grid`、`plugin-form`、`plugin-view` 仍在首屏:它们被控制台外壳按名字导入的辅助函数拉住(拆它们要给共享包新增无副作用子路径,属 PR 2),详见 Acceptance notes。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx(`ObjectView` 改为 `routeChunk.lazy` 并加入预加载表)、ui/apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts(`plugin-list` 改为三条 `registerLazy`)、ui/scripts/vite-declared-lazy-views.ts(新的正控 `ConsoleLayout` 与新台账 `DECLARED_LAZY_VIEWS_WITH_SIDE_EFFECTS`)。
- 两分钟验证:在 `ui/apps/console` 跑 `CI=true pnpm exec vite build`,读 `dist/eager-closure.json` 的 `eagerGzipBytes`,应约为 2,060,434;打开任一对象列表点开一条记录,抽屉正常画出详情。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Measured first, on `origin/main` `3c0033f9`, with #33580's instrument (the console's own `vite.config.ts` run through Vite's `build()` with one read-only plugin dumping the module graph; same `eager-closure.json` as a plain build): **107 eager chunks, 2,165,721 B gzip**. The five chunks the card names: `plugin-grid` 160,144 · `plugin-form` 44,267 · `RecordDetailView` 27,317 · `plugins-views` (plugin-list + plugin-detail group) 39,465 · `plugin-view` 16,067 = **287,260 B**.

Three cuts, in the order the order lists them:

1. **`ObjectView` is a route element.** `console/AppContent.tsx` declared it in its always-eager block; it is now `routeChunk.lazy(() => import('../views/ObjectView.js'))` like the other route views, and its two paths (`:objectName`, `:objectName/view/:viewId`) join `APP_ROUTE_CHUNKS`, so its chunk starts downloading as soon as the route is known, in parallel with the route's metadata reads (the existing `preloadableLazy` path). `ObjectNotFoundState`, which AppContent also draws, is imported from its own module (`views/objectViewChrome.js`) instead of through `ObjectView.js`. `ObjectView.tsx` itself is not touched.
2. **`RecordDetailView` is lazy in the record pane.** `views/objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx` imported it statically; it is now `lazy()` inside a `Suspense` whose fallback is the existing `SkeletonDetail`. With cut 1 alone the view already leaves the first load (the overlay rides in the `ObjectView` chunk); this boundary keeps it out of the list route too, so a list that never opens a record never downloads it (probe below: `list` requests no `RecordDetailView` chunk, `list-drawer` does).
3. **`plugin-list` registers lazily.** `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts` bare-imported five plugins. Measured one at a time by dropping each import: only `@object-ui/plugin-list` moves the closure (−40,068 B, the whole `plugins-views` chunk). It now registers `list-view`, `view:list` (`skipFallback`) and `object-gallery` as `registerLazy` stubs with the namespaces the package itself registers. `plugin-grid`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-view` and `plugin-detail` stay eager imports: each is held by another eager edge (Acceptance notes), so a stub would move nothing; the order's "as far as the measure shows a closure win".

`ui/scripts/vite-declared-lazy-views.ts` follows the graph:

- `EAGER_WALK_CONTROL`, counter-probe 2's positive control, was `ObjectView.tsx`, which is no longer eager. It is now `packages/app-shell/src/layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx`, imported by the same always-eager block and drawn around every route.
- The plugin's `missing` half fired on the cut build for `RecordDetailView.tsx` (pinned, no longer eager), so its line leaves `DECLARED_LAZY_VIEWS_STILL_EAGER`, which is now empty.
- Unpinned, `RecordDetailView.tsx` would be declared `moduleSideEffects: false`, and guard 2 rightly refuses that: it bare-imports `./record-approvals-renderer.js`. A new frozen ledger, `DECLARED_LAZY_VIEWS_WITH_SIDE_EFFECTS`, lists declared-lazy views the plugin weighs like the rest (eager and unpinned still fails the build) but never declares pure. The plugin refuses a stale entry (no bare side-effect import and not named in its package's `sideEffects` array). `RecordDetailView` is lazy without the declaration, measured: nothing in the eager graph reaches it but the package barrel, which the package's own `sideEffects` array already leaves shakeable.

Result on the same instrument, head `b5429992` (sources identical to the measured build): **103 eager chunks, 2,060,434 B gzip, −105,287 B (−4.9%)**. The real console build (`pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build`, tsc + vite + manifest) reads 2,165,724 → 2,060,438 on the same two trees; the 3–4 B is build-to-build variance.

| chunk (card) | before, B gz | after | status |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `RecordDetailView` | 27,317 | — | **left the eager closure** |
| `plugins-views` (plugin-list + detail group) | 39,465 | — | **left the eager closure** |
| `plugin-grid` | 160,144 | 160,137 | eager, held elsewhere (notes) |
| `plugin-form` | 44,267 | 44,270 | eager, held elsewhere (notes) |
| `plugin-view` | 16,067 | 16,056 | eager, held elsewhere (notes) |
| **five-chunk sum** | **287,260** | **220,463** | **−66,797** |

Also left: `objectViewTitleSwitcher` (16,825), most of `index` (137,209 → 108,359), `newViewSpec`, `PageHeader`, `createDerive`, `recordDetailSections`, `MetadataInspector`, `useDatasetCatalog`, `deriveRelatedLists` and a few small ones. Seven small chunks appear (largest `studioScope` 12,223, `objectViewChrome` 5,298, `recordDrawerStack` 4,760): modules that were already eager inside `index` and the chunks that left, regrouped by rolldown, ⛔ not new first-load bytes (the total is the measure).

The eager-closure gate's ceiling does not move; `BASELINE` is untouched.

Changeset `.changeset/33581-console-eager-closure-list-and-record.md`: `@object-ui/console` patch (app-shell is private; the console's `dist` ships it, and `register-plugins.ts` is the console's own).

## Tests

- `scripts/__tests__/vite-declared-lazy-views.test.ts` (34 tests, pass): the control is read from AppContent's `ConsoleLayout` import line; `ObjectView.tsx` is a parsed declaration (13 files, was 12); the new ledger is sorted, exists, is declared lazy, and every entry really carries a bare side-effect import and is not also pinned eager; the "every unpinned declared view is pure" pin excludes it; the attached-prose pins cover the new constant; the eager ledger records empty.
- Console registry suites read `list-view` from its package now that the console registers a stub: `public-contract.test.ts` lists `list-view` among the tags reached through a pending stub; `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` and `htmlTierDataSourceInputDeclaration-6678.test.tsx` import `@object-ui/plugin-list` beside `register-plugins`, the remedy `registry-inputs-spec-parity` already uses for kanban, calendar, tree, map, gantt and timeline, and the way `dev/manifest-registry.ts` loads it before writing the published manifest.
- Affected suites, from `ui/` under the lock: every `AppContent.*` suite (app-shell and console), every `ObjectView.*` suite (the record drawer opens through the lazy pane in `ObjectView.recordDrawer-27545` and the record-open pins), the four `RecordDetailView` suites that mount the overlay, and all 22 suites that import `register-plugins`: **178 files, 1886 tests**. First run: 175 files passed, 3 failed (the three registry suites above, 8 tests, all reading `list-view` as eagerly loaded); after the fix the three pass (285 tests).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0. ESLint `--no-inline-config` on the eight changed source and test files: 0 errors (53 pre-existing warnings, none on a changed line).

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restore proven: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- New control: `EAGER_WALK_CONTROL` pointed back at the lazy `ObjectView.tsx` ⇒ the console build fails, `counter-probe failed: packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx is not in the eager closure`. The probe still fires.
- Stale side-effect entry: the ledger line `RecordDetailView.tsx` replaced by the pure `ObjectView.tsx` ⇒ the build fails, `ObjectView.tsx is in DECLARED_LAZY_VIEWS_WITH_SIDE_EFFECTS but carries no bare side-effect import ...`.
- Record pane boundary put back to a static import ⇒ build green, closure 2,059,952 (−482 B against head: regrouping), and the graph shows `RecordDetailView` as a static import of the `ObjectView` chunk. As stated in cut 2: on the first load the record pane boundary is neutral; it is the list route's saving, which the browser probe reads.
- Nothing catches the plugin-list import coming back (+40,068 B): `check:eager-closure`'s sensitivity is 695 KiB by ruling, the reading #33580 recorded. No pin is added (a new gate).

## Acceptance notes

**What still holds the three remaining chunks** (module graph of the cut build, shortest eager chunk path):

- `plugin-grid`: `hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts` (reached from `ConsoleShell` → `useUserLocale` / `useHomeInbox`) imports `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, which the `plugin-grid` group captures; dropping every bare import in `register-plugins.ts` and the `dev/DevRowActions` edge too still leaves it eager. The eleven `plugin-detail` reach-ins are PR 2's.
- `plugin-form`: `providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`, `console/AppContent.tsx` and `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` import named helpers from the package entry, which keeps the whole registering entry (PR 2's side-effect-free subpaths).
- `plugin-view`: `console/AppContent.tsx` imports `deriveRecordSurface` / `deriveRecordFlowSurface` from the entry (PR 2).
- `apps/console/src/App.tsx` imports `dev/DevRowActions.tsx` (a dev-only `/dev/row-actions` harness) statically, an `ObjectGrid` edge into `plugin-grid`. Measured inert today (−934 B when cut, because the edges above hold the chunk); it becomes a real edge once PR 2 lands. `carrier: #33581 PR 2`.
- A `list-view` / `object-gallery` stub carries only the namespace and category until the package loads, so `ComponentRegistry.getConfig` answers no `inputs` for them before first use, the same as every other lazy plugin (kanban, calendar, dashboard). The published manifest is built by `dev/manifest-registry.ts`, which imports the package eagerly, so `sdui.manifest.json` is unchanged (`node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0).
- The seat note to use `React.lazy` at the boundary and not a second lazy wrapper is followed: the record pane uses `React.lazy`, the route uses AppContent's own `routeChunk.lazy`; no shared `lazyPage` helper is needed.

**A built console in a real browser, before and after.** Showcase built at this tree (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/example-showcase...' build`), the console built for real (`pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/console build:dist`) once with the base sources (`3c0033f9`'s `ui/packages/app-shell/src`, `ui/apps/console/src`, `ui/scripts`) and once at head, each served by `pnpm dev --fresh` from `examples/app-showcase`; headless Chromium, a fresh context (cold cache) per route, signed in as the dev admin. "chunks" = which of the watched chunks the route requested.

| route | before: drew · chunks | after: drew · chunks |
|:--|:--|:--|
| dashboard `showcase_ops_dashboard` | yes · RecordDetailView, plugins-views | yes · **none of** ObjectView, RecordDetailView, plugins-views |
| list `showcase_task` | yes (10 rows) · RecordDetailView, plugins-views | yes (10 rows) · ObjectView, plugins-views; **no** RecordDetailView |
| list + drawer `?recordId=` | yes, drawer open | yes, drawer open · ObjectView, plugins-views, RecordDetailView |
| record page `/record/ID` | yes | yes · RecordDetailView; **no** ObjectView, plugins-views |
| saved view `view/cards` (gallery, `object-gallery` stub) | yes | yes · ObjectView, plugins-views |
| saved view `view/board` (kanban) | yes | yes · ObjectView, plugins-views |
| Studio `/studio` | yes | yes |
| Setup → Packages | yes | yes · none of the three |

No page error, no console error, no failed request on any route, before or after. The page text length is identical before and after on every route that does not show a record (1638, 2092, 1643, 1812, 1147, 1092 characters); the two record routes show a different record on each run (`--fresh` seeds new ids), so their lengths differ by the record. Screenshots, `routes.json` for both runs, the probe and both `eager-closure.json` files are in the project folder `pm-orders/ui/33581-probe/`.
